name: The Nutcracker by Rio Grande Valley Ballet
paras: The Rio Grande Valley Ballet presents its 54th anniversary Nutcracker at the McAllen Performing Arts Center, with a live orchestra conducted by Dr. Norman Gamboa. Deborah Case is the artistic director, and international guest artists Kirill Kruhlov and Emily Abrom join the cast.

There are two afternoon shows, Saturday December 12 and Sunday December 13, both at 3 PM. The listing bills it as a holiday classic for the whole family, and tickets go through Ticketmaster and the venue box office.
tip: Both shows start at 3 PM, so the Sunday show leaves the rest of the weekend free.
